nodes.name: ci.yaml
nodes.summary: Continuous integration workflow that builds the Deno module, fetches dependencies, and runs tests, benchmarks, lint, and formatting checks on push and pull requests to main across Ubuntu and Windows runners.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a matrix strategy to run the same job on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest, with Deno installation caching.

nodes.name: issues.yaml
nodes.summary: Issue automation workflow that applies a 'triage' label to newly opened or reopened GitHub issues via the gh CLI.

nodes.name: publish-ai.yaml
nodes.summary: Release publishing workflow that builds and pushes multi-arch AI daemon Docker images (Deno 1.x and 2.x variants, bundled with Node, GitHub CLI, and Claude Code) to GitHub Container Registry on tag push.
nodes.languageNotes: Generates Dockerfiles inline via heredoc and builds linux/amd64,linux/arm64 images with docker buildx; tags 'latest' only for non-prerelease versions.

nodes.name: publish.yaml
nodes.summary: Release publishing workflow that publishes the main, scripts, and dev packages to JSR and builds/pushes multi-arch builder Docker images (Deno 1.x and 2.x) to GitHub Container Registry on tag push.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines JSR package publishing with inline-generated Alpine Dockerfiles built via docker buildx for amd64 and arm64.

nodes.name: release.yaml
nodes.summary: Release workflow that creates a GitHub Release with auto-generated notes for pushed tags, marking prerelease when the tag contains rc-, preview, beta, alpha, or next.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses actions/github-script to call the GitHub REST API and detect prerelease tags by substring matching.

nodes.name: releaser.yaml
nodes.summary: Release tagging workflow that opens version-bump discussion comments on PRs (emoji-voting for patch/minor/major) and, on merge to main or next, determines and pushes the appropriate semantic version or prerelease tag.
nodes.languageNotes: Computes next semantic versions from git tags via shell, and uses emoji reaction counts on a PR comment to choose the bump level.

nodes.name: update.yml
nodes.summary: Scheduled daily workflow that runs the boywithkeyboard/updater action to open dependency-update pull requests.
nodes.languageNotes: Triggered by a daily cron schedule with manual workflow_dispatch fallback.

nodes.name: tag-discussion
nodes.summary: Job that calculates next patch/minor/major versions from git tags and posts a tagging-options discussion comment on PRs targeting main.

nodes.name: prerelease-tag-discussion
nodes.summary: Job that posts a prerelease tagging-options discussion comment on PRs targeting the next branch.

nodes.name: determine-tag
nodes.summary: Job that runs on push to main to determine and push the chosen semantic version tag based on the PR's emoji votes.

nodes.name: determine-prerelease-tag
nodes.summary: Job that runs on push to next to determine and push the appropriate prerelease tag.
